description.zh: 在搜索结果里调整主题、音量、蓝牙和 WLAN、资源管理器选项，保持电脑唤醒，或关机、重启、睡眠
description.en: Change theme, volume, Bluetooth/WLAN, Explorer options and keep-awake from search results, or shut down, restart and sleep

title.zh: 搜索结果里的电源命令

hint.zh: 关机、重启电脑、睡眠、休眠、锁定屏幕、注销；除锁屏外都要再按一次 Enter 确认
hint.en: Shut down, restart, sleep, hibernate, lock screen and sign out; all but lock ask for a second Enter

title.zh: 保持唤醒时合盖也不睡眠
title.en: Keep awake with the lid closed too

hint.zh: 合上盖子照常运行，适合听歌、下载；结束后自动改回。装包前记得结束
hint.en: The laptop keeps running with the lid closed, for music or downloads; put back when it ends. End it before packing the laptop away
